explanation: `\alph`/`\Alph` can only represent 1 through 26 (there are only 26 letters), and `\roman`/`\Roman` have a similar practical limit — the counter being printed here has climbed past what the chosen format can show. Use `\arabic` for this counter instead, or check why it has reached such a large value.
title: A counter's value is too large for this format
